description: POST /{Phone-Number-ID}/media is modeled as a JSON body whose `file` is a string (the spec's examples are curl `-F` arguments such as `@/local/path/file.jpg;type=image/jpeg`). Meta's media guide (https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/business-phone-numbers/media) uploads as `multipart/form-data` with three parts: `file` (the bytes), `type` (the MIME type) and `messaging_product: whatsapp`. Live on 2026-11-18 (v23.0) a multipart request with those parts returned `{ id }`. The operation becomes multipart, `file` binary and required, `messaging_product` required, and `type` is added.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The media file. A `File` keeps its name; a `Blob` or bytes are sent under the part name.
MIME type of the file, e.g. `image/jpeg`, `audio/ogg`, `application/pdf`.
